_meta: Machinevertaling (nl naar en) van de eigen factcheck klaver-nepartikel van Factiz, eigen werk van de redactie (B82, B84), door claude-sonnet-5-5, eigenvertaling-v1; doublecheck/eigenvertaling.py, PLAN #37.8.

velden.kop: Jesse Klaver never said he wants to abolish private ownership, the quote dates from 2020
velden.oordeel_zin: The quote comes from an anonymous blog on Medium from October 2020, and according to his spokesperson Klaver never said it [2] [7].
velden.bewering: Jesse Klaver (GL): "If I win the elections, I will abolish private ownership."
velden.kort: On 5 October a screenshot circulated on X of a quote in which Jesse Klaver says he will abolish private ownership if he wins the elections [1]. Klaver never said that: the quote comes from a blog that an anonymous writer put on Medium in October 2020 [2] [7]. The blog is gone, but the quote kept coming back in 2022, 2025 and 2026 [1] [7] [8].
velden.tekst:
The screenshot appeared on Monday 5 October at 2:37 pm on X, with the text "Look, this is a real communist." [1]. On 18 November the post had 953 likes and 186 replies [1]. Context was added to it that same afternoon [1].

The quote is older than the post. On Wednesday 14 October 2020, an account on X shared a link to a blog on Medium, a platform where anyone can write [2]. The headline of that blog was the quote [2]. A few hours later, the CIDI, the Centrum Informatie en Documentatie Israël, wrote that Klaver was trending because of an antisemitic article claiming that he wanted to abolish private ownership [3]. According to the CIDI, the author also wrote that Klaver supposedly has a Jewish mother [3].

There is no interview, speech or manifesto in which Klaver says this. In 2022, dpa found no medium that had recorded the statement; all references led back to the blog, which the writer had meanwhile taken down [7]. Klaver's spokesperson told dpa that he never said it [7]. The 2021 election manifesto of GroenLinks was called Tijd voor nieuw realisme, with Klaver as lead candidate [5]. According to dpa, the words "privébezit" and "privé-eigendom" do not appear in it [7].

After that, the quote kept returning. In February 2022 it was on Facebook [7]. In October 2025, during the campaign for the House of Representatives elections of 29 October, screenshots circulated again, and the spokesperson called it fake news [8]. After the post of 5 October 2026, Knack also wrote that there is no evidence for the quote [9].

In 2020, Klaver was parliamentary leader of GroenLinks [4]. GroenLinks and the PvdA merged into Progressief Nederland, PRO, on 13 June 2026 [6]. Klaver is now parliamentary leader of PRO in the House of Representatives [4].
velden.niet_weten: We don't know who wrote the blog, nor whether it was meant as a joke.
nog_uitzoeken: Whether the quote was also circulating in March 2021 and November 2023.
A response from Klaver's spokesperson at PRO to the 2026 post.
tijdlijn: An account on X shares the link to the blog on Medium, with the quote as headline [2].
The CIDI calls the article antisemitic and fake [3].
dpa: the statement is made up [7].
AFP Factcheck Nederland, taken over by deCheckers: false [8].

beeld_alt: Screenshot of an article with a made-up quote from Jesse Klaver about abolishing private ownership. Stamp: FALSE.
